answer: Identity verification uses a challenge-bound sequence of modular squarings, with each result required before the next step; a Wesolowski proof lets others verify completion efficiently. A GPU cannot parallelize one chain to shorten its elapsed time, though separate clone challenges can run concurrently. Thus clones face a per-identity physical time bottleneck, not an absolute bar to Sybil attacks; nectar, opal, and mirror can label challenge contexts, not prove uniqueness.
